text:
matt_sales: Hey team — Acme POC kicked off. Need a hosted API key for them with IP allowlist and 30-day expiry. Can someone provision? Need rotation plan and audit logs for SOC2 review. cc @ashley_se @julia_security

ashley_se: Congrats! Quick Q: POC timeframe? And do they need embeddings + chat or just generation? For hosted keys we can create scoped keys and set TTL. Recommend 7-30d short-lived and rotate daily if they integrate long-term.

matt_sales: They want chat + embeddings. POC is 3 weeks, might extend. Prefer IP allowlist to their corp CIDR. Also they asked for key revocation flow.

ashley_se: Got it. We can create a scoped key: scope=chat,embeddings; set expiration=2026-04-09T12:00:00Z. We can add allowed_ips=['198.51.100.0/24'] (or their CIDR). Rotation options: a) daily rotating short-lived keys via our API b) client-managed secrets w/ KMS. For POC I suggest one time-limited hosted key + rotation script.

omar_infra: To create via API use: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/poc-keys -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"customer":"acme","scopes":["chat","embeddings"],"expires_at":"2026-04-09T12:00:00Z","allowed_ips":["198.51.100.0/24"]}'
We return key_id and secret. We store secret only once; record key_id in audit.

julia_security: :eyes: reminder: for enterprise POCs we require MFA on the account creating keys, audit log retention 1 year, and the key description must include POC owner. Also require a revoke window SLA (we aim for immediate revocation, but propagate up to 60s).

matt_sales: Can we get the key TTL shorter? They want 24h TTL with daily rotation script. Who owns rotation?

ashley_se: We can set TTL=24h. I'll provision a service account and give them a sample rotation script. Sample rotation endpoint:

POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate
Response: {"new_secret":"sk_live_...","old_key_id":"..."}

Rotation is a manual or automated call from their infra — we'll give webhook creds or they can call from their CI.

omar_infra: Note: hosted keys can't be used for Dedicated pools. If they later move to Dedicated, keys are different and we migrate tokens. Also IP allowlist only on hosted keys for now.

matt_sales: Thanks. Please go ahead. @ashley_se to provision and I'll coordinate distribution with Acme SRE. Need audit confirmation once done.

deploy-bot: audit-log: key_create by ashley_se key_id=key_9a8b7c at 1769998895

ashley_se: Done: key_id=key_9a8b7c, expires=2026-04-09T12:00:00Z, allowed_ips=[198.51.100.0/24], scopes=[chat,embeddings]. Shared secret via 1Password vault 'acme-poc' and gave access to matt_sales and acme SRE. Rotation script in wiki: https://docs.redwood.com/pocs/key-rotation. cc @julia_security

julia_security: Verified audit entry and 1Password sharing. Leaving a note for SOC2: retention policy applied. :white_check_mark:

matt_sales: Perfect. I'll confirm with Acme and close loop. If they extend past 3 weeks we'll set up daily rotation automation.
